query: UPDATE user_api_token SET name = COALESCE($1, name), token_nbf = CASE WHEN $2 THEN NULL WHEN $3::TIMESTAMPTZ IS NOT NULL THEN $3 ELSE token_nbf END, token_exp = CASE WHEN $4 THEN NULL WHEN $5::TIMESTAMPTZ IS NOT NULL THEN $5 ELSE token_exp END, allowed_ips = CASE WHEN $6 THEN NULL WHEN $7::INET[] IS NOT NULL THEN $7 ELSE allowed_ips END WHERE token_id = $8 AND user_id = $9;
